segments.name: Digital Advertising
segments.description: Provides AI-driven data and advertising technology that places digital advertising across devices, websites, applications and browsers for agencies, brands and large advertising platforms.
segments.evidence: We operate as a single reportable segment that places digital advertising throughout devices, websites, applications and browsers across social, search and programmatic advertising channels, facilitating the delivery of millions of advertising messages monthly.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers, agencies and large advertising platforms pay Inuvo for placing digital advertising, with revenue measured after deducting marketing expenses, exchange fees and publisher payments.
revenueModel.evidence: The CODM evaluates performance and allocates resources based on contribution margin, which is calculated as revenue after deducting marketing expenses, exchange fees, and publisher payments.
